title: Validated agronomic defaults for the Mexico Agroclimate Research Tool

core_method.important_distinction: Ecological rainfall envelopes are not crop water requirements and must be stored separately.
core_method.planting_calendar_rule: Do not use one national fixed month sequence. Use state × crop × cycle × irrigation regime from SIAP or local agronomic guidance.

evidence_grades.A: Official crop-specific standard or direct peer-reviewed field measurement
evidence_grades.B: Authoritative broad ecological envelope or strong regional evidence
evidence_grades.D: Insufficient evidence; no default should be generated

app_replacement_rules.replacement: Require planting date or state/cycle/irrigation-mode calendar; derive stages from day lengths
app_replacement_rules.basis: SIAP calendar and local INIFAP guidance
app_replacement_rules.rationale: Mexico has spring–summer and autumn–winter cycles, irrigated and rainfed systems. One national month sequence is not defensible.

app_replacement_rules.replacement: Use broad rainfall envelope only for ecological screening; use ETc = Kc × ETo for water adequacy
app_replacement_rules.rationale: Rainfall totals are not equivalent to crop water supply and should not be universal stage thresholds.

app_replacement_rules.replacement: Use actual/maximum ET ratio and Ky: 1 − Ya/Ym = Ky(1 − ETa/ETm)
app_replacement_rules.rationale: A fixed deficit in mm has different biological meaning across climate, crop duration, soil and stage.

app_replacement_rules.current_component: Single crop-wide Kc in irrigation estimator
app_replacement_rules.replacement: Use stage-specific Kc curve; adjust Kc ini for wetting frequency and local climate
app_replacement_rules.rationale: Kc changes across development and with canopy/ground cover.

app_replacement_rules.replacement: Offer Hass-like composite plus Mexican, Guatemalan and West Indian race profiles
app_replacement_rules.rationale: Avocado races have materially different temperature envelopes.

app_replacement_rules.replacement: Display observed cultivated-site climate ranges; no precise irrigation score until local Kc/calibration exists
app_replacement_rules.rationale: Available evidence supports observational zoning, not universal physiological limits or Kc.

app_replacement_rules.replacement: Expose age/canopy/shade/pruning selector; default productive full-sun Kc ≈0.95 with warning
app_replacement_rules.rationale: Published Kc spans roughly 0.44–1.50 depending on system.

app_replacement_rules.current_component: Perennial crop 'full growing season' precipitation sums
app_replacement_rules.replacement: Use annual climate envelope and annual/monthly orchard Kc
app_replacement_rules.rationale: Perennials transpire year-round and do not follow one annual crop cycle.

app_replacement_rules.replacement: Require user value or fit against observed yield data; label any fallback as illustrative
app_replacement_rules.rationale: Potential yield is cultivar-, environment- and management-specific.

app_replacement_rules.replacement: Label as application-defined index and expose weights/sensitivity
app_replacement_rules.rationale: Validated crop inputs do not validate a custom composite score.

app_replacement_rules.replacement: Label as exploratory application-defined rankings; show component values
app_replacement_rules.rationale: Do not imply agronomic or economic recommendation.

app_replacement_rules.replacement: Label as conventional app categories, not published crop standards
app_replacement_rules.rationale: Scores are continuous model outputs; categorical labels are convenience thresholds.

app_replacement_rules.current_component: Temperature thresholds copied identically to every stage
app_replacement_rules.replacement: Apply broad crop envelope by default; use stage-specific temperature rules only where directly supported
app_replacement_rules.rationale: Stage-specific thresholds are often cultivar- and context-dependent.

app_replacement_rules.replacement: Display source title, URL, evidence grade, parameter basis and last review date beside defaults
app_replacement_rules.rationale: Allows peer review, audit and future updating.

app_replacement_rules.current_component: No distinction between ecological rainfall and crop water use
app_replacement_rules.rationale: These quantities answer different questions and must not share the same field.

evidence_gaps.gap: Universal Kc, Ky, absolute temperature limits and stage-specific ET demand
evidence_gaps.recommended_action: Do not generate irrigation/yield-loss defaults. Obtain INIFAP or field-calibrated parameters for target denomination-of-origin zones.

evidence_gaps.gap: Universal stage-specific Kc and water-deficit threshold
evidence_gaps.recommended_action: Use age/canopy/shade-specific options; validate in Mexican coffee regions.

evidence_gaps.gap: Mexico-specific Hass Kc and crop-water requirement across production regions
evidence_gaps.recommended_action: Use 0.55–0.85 as a research prior; calibrate with Mexican orchard ET or irrigation records.

evidence_gaps.gap: Barley-specific Kc/Ky in the reviewed official sources
evidence_gaps.recommended_action: Use transparent small-grain proxy and flag it in the interface.
Import SIAP calendars by state, cycle and irrigation regime; permit local user overrides.
Add optional cultivar profiles and growing-degree-day phenology when reliable sources are available.

evidence_gaps.gap: Soil-water storage, rooting depth, runoff and effective rainfall
evidence_gaps.recommended_action: Add a soil-water balance layer before calling irrigation estimates operational.

evidence_gaps.gap: Validated potential yield and response calibration
evidence_gaps.recommended_action: Train/calibrate against SIAP or experimental observed yields; remove universal ceilings.
